what: a 8x5 bar swept along a line-arc-line path (quarter circle r30 between two 30 mm legs), shelled 0.5 mm open at its start
method: path length L=30+15*pi+30. The section's centroid is on the path, so by Pappus V_bar=40*L. The cavity is the sweep of the 7x4 section (concentric offsets of the swept walls; the tightest radius 30-3.5 stays positive) from the open start to 0.5 mm short of the end: 28*(L-0.5). V=40*L-28*(L-0.5)
